answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before trading, tied to a verifiable work history. Newcomers start on the lowest terrace of trust: small trades only, each completed job adding a rung. Peers mirror each other's reputation records across independent registries, so a fake identity cannot inflate its own score — the registries must agree. An attacker spawning a thousand sock puppets must fund a stake for each, and their empty histories leave them stranded on the bottom knoll of the ladder, unable to reach high-value work.
